resources.string: End-to-end encrypted

Messages and attachments you send in this chat can be read only by you and %1$s. Not even Samvad can read them. Reaction emoji, who you talk to and when are not hidden, and calls are not end-to-end encrypted.
Encryption was turned on later
Messages sent since %1$s are end-to-end encrypted: only you and %2$s can read them. Earlier messages were not encrypted and stay as they are.
Not end-to-end encrypted
Samvad\'s servers can read the messages in this chat. You can turn on end-to-end encryption for new messages. Earlier messages stay as they are and will not be encrypted.
Samvad\'s servers can read the messages in this chat. %1$s can\'t use end-to-end encryption yet, for example because their app is older, so this chat stays as it is.
Groups are not end-to-end encrypted
Messages, polls and Moments in groups can be read by Samvad\'s servers. End-to-end encryption works only in one-to-one chats.

How end-to-end encryption works in Samvad
Protected in encrypted chats

• Text, replies, edits, deletions, shared contacts, photos, voice notes, videos and files are encrypted on your phone before they are sent. Only you and the other person can read them.\n• Samvad\'s servers can\'t read them, and neither can anyone who gets hold of the server\'s data.
Still visible to Samvad
• Who talks to whom, when, and the kind of message (text, photo, voice and so on).\n• Reaction emoji, delivered and read times, and the size of what you send.\n• Your name and profile.
Not end-to-end encrypted

• Group chats, polls and Moments.
• Voice and video calls: they are encrypted on their way, but not end-to-end.
• Chats marked “Not end-to-end encrypted”, and messages sent before a chat was upgraded.
• Scheduled messages, which are not available in encrypted chats.
One phone per account

• Your keys live only on this phone and are never backed up. If you sign in on a new phone, old encrypted messages can\'t be recovered, and your contacts see “Security code changed”.\n• Signing out erases the keys and the decrypted messages from this phone.
Reporting

Samvad can\'t see messages in an encrypted chat. If you report someone, you choose whether to include their latest messages, which your phone decrypts and sends. Samvad cannot check that they are genuine.
This chat is end-to-end encrypted, so Samvad can\'t see its messages. You can choose to include the person\'s latest messages with your report.
